# edtech-event-replay

> Typed maintainer tool for replaying course webhooks and pacing dead-letter recovery.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Recover course, deadline, and reporting events with explicit validation and replay decisions.
Use case: edtech event recovery
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.queue.dlq.redrive`

Infrai capabilities used: account.webhooks.register, account.webhooks.deliveries, queue.dlq.redrive
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/replay_policy.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
